from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,collections,re
root=Path.cwd(); out=root/'.work/workload-phases-20261116'
base=root/'zig-out/bin/sigma.exe'; prof=root/'.work/workload-profile-20261116/bin/sigma.exe'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
report={'scope':'Compiled operation counts only; no timing. Load includes reading, interpretation and compilation, not separate I/O cost. No GUI/input polling/audio/frame waits.','baseline_sha256':sha(base),'profile_sha256':sha(prof),'cases':[]}
assert report['baseline_sha256']=='379d6c6c069b9c3072da22fa6cea8b7deff77c5ed78ef9bbd070f92a724337bf'
setups={'pinball':'BUILD-WALLS 12345 SEED ! NEW-GAME','waterworks':'12345 SEED ! NEW-RUN','klondike':'1 START-DEAL'}
actions={'pinball':': EXTRA 10 0 DO 112 KEY! 112 KEY! 114 KEY! LOOP ; EXTRA SCORE @ . PAUSED @ .',
'waterworks':': EXTRA 10 0 DO K-RIGHT KEY! K-DOWN KEY! 122 KEY! 112 KEY! 112 KEY! 114 KEY! LOOP ; EXTRA SCORE @ . CUR-X @ . CUR-Y @ .',
'klondike':': EXTRA 10 0 DO 32 KEY! 117 KEY! 104 KEY! 100 KEY! 114 KEY! LOOP ; EXTRA MOVES @ . SCORE @ .'}
for game in setups:
 source=root/f'examples/{game}.fs'; prefix=['-e','0 CONSTANT NO-AUTORUN 0 CONSTANT NO-SOUND']
 for phase in ['load','bake','initialize','extra-keys']:
  before=prefix.copy(); after=[]
  if phase=='load': after=[str(source),'-e','DEPTH . BYE']
  else:
   before += [str(source)]
   if phase=='extra-keys': before += ['-e',setups[game]+(' -1 D-SRC ! -1 HOVER !' if game=='klondike' else '')]
   code={'bake':'BAKE-ALL','initialize':setups[game],'extra-keys':actions[game]}[phase]
   after=['-e',code+' DEPTH . BYE']
  name=f'{game}-{phase}'; runs=[]
  for i in range(3):
   cmd=[str(base if i==0 else prof),*([] if i==0 else ['--profile']),*before,*([] if i==0 else ['--measure-profile-reset']),*after]
   p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,capture_output=True,timeout=240)
   (out/f'{name}-{i}.stdout').write_bytes(p.stdout);(out/f'{name}-{i}.stderr').write_bytes(p.stderr)
   assert p.returncode==0,(name,i,p.returncode,p.stderr[-400:])
   ops=[];total=0
   if i:
    text=p.stderr.decode(); total=int(re.search(r'PROFILE: (\d+) OPERATIONS',text).group(1))
    for line in text.splitlines():
     if line.startswith('MEASURE-OP '):
      _,pc,n,kind,builtin=line.split();ops.append({'pc':int(pc),'count':int(n),'kind':kind,'builtin':builtin})
    assert sum(x['count'] for x in ops)==total
   runs.append({'command':cmd,'exit':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout.decode(),'total':total,'ops':ops})
  assert runs[0]['stdout']==runs[1]['stdout']==runs[2]['stdout'],name
  assert runs[1]['ops']==runs[2]['ops'],name
  counts=collections.Counter()
  for x in runs[1]['ops']: counts[x['builtin'] if x['builtin']!='-' else x['kind']]+=x['count']
  report['cases'].append({'name':name,'source_sha256':sha(source),'runs':runs,'counts':dict(counts.most_common())})
  (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(name,total,{k:counts[k] for k in ['minus_rot','two_r_fetch','two_r_from','d_negate']},flush=True)
report['script']=Path(__file__).read_text();report['checks']='12 cases, baseline stdout parity, repeat counts parity; native/interpreted work not covered'
(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
